comment: A Duel's podium and instant rematch on Larak Lot: one rule bot, a joined human who stands still, a short frag limit. Run with FRAGR_QA_MODE=duel, FRAGR_QA_BOTS=1, FRAGR_QA_FRAG_LIMIT=2 and FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/duel-rematch.json.

states.name: duel_live
states.note: One versus one: the mode chip names the Duel and the room holds two fighters.

states.name: duel_podium
states.note: The result card and the podium plate: the series so far and the fire key for one more round.

states.name: duel_again_pressed
states.note: Fire pressed: the plate says the next round is loading.

states.name: duel_rematch
states.note: The rematch opens two seconds after the result, with the Host on the series.
